summary: Nick Feinstein, 22, killed in an avalanche on Peak 10 after exiting Breckenridge Ski Resort through a backcountry access gate with his father Andy Feinstein
location: Peak 10, the Numbers area (south-southeast facing, ~11,600 ft), outside Breckenridge Ski Resort
responding_agency: Summit County Rescue Group, Summit County Sheriff's Office Special Operations Unit, Breckenridge Ski Patrol
notes: New Year's Eve ~1:00 p.m.: both skiers caught; Andy Feinstein partially buried and self-extricated, called 911 at 1:40 p.m. from a spot with cell service. SCRG + SCSO Special Ops + Breckenridge Ski Patrol responded; avalanche dog team located Nick Feinstein at 3:11 p.m., deceased. CAIC preliminary report; CAIC rated danger considerable with large dangerous avalanches easy to trigger. Surfaced via the CSAR sidecountry-is-backcountry piece ('in December of 2022 there was a fatality in the backcountry adjacent to Breckenridge Ski Resort'). Uninjured companion not counted.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Tenmile Range Peak 10)
